title: Intelligence activity on Native American lands (The Octopus Murders)

tellings.quote: You actually you could watch a really popular Netflix show right now called The Octopus Murders.

plain: Intelligence work is said to have been carried out on Native American reservations, with the private security company Wackenhut among those involved. Michels raises it in an interview with a helicopter pilot named Jake Barber, sending viewers to a popular Netflix series called The Octopus Murders rather than to a witness, as a hint that secret government activity has used these lands.
